observed.caption: A wide urban street lined with tall buildings and trees, with cars driving and parked along both sides and a few people crossing the road under an overcast sky.
observed.description: The photo shows a wide asphalt street extending into the distance, flanked on both sides by multi-story buildings with many windows and by mature trees with green foliage. Several vehicles are visible, including a black SUV in the left foreground driving away and a white hatchback in the center lane, with rows of parked cars along both curbs. A few small human figures are walking on the road and sidewalks. On the right side a red and white billboard is mounted on a pole next to a tree, and commercial buildings with signage line the street. The sky above is pale and overcast, and the lighting is diffused daylight.
